title: Heidi Klum's Halloween Party 2026: All the Celebrity Costumes on the Red Carpet
text:
Heidi Klum's Halloween Party 2026: All the Celebrity Costumes on the Red Carpet 
 Latest Photos Videos Kardashians Watch E! Shop Latest Photos Videos Kardashians Watch E! Shop Heidi Klum's Halloween Party 2026: All the Celebrity Costumes on the Red Carpet
 16 photos Nov 01, 2026 4:04 AM Link Copied 1 / 16 Noam Galai/Getty Images for Heidi Klum Heidi Klum
 The model's costume is hands down one of her best, as she dressed as her real left hand—including her wedding ring from husband Tom Kaulitz. 
 2 / 16 Noam Galai/Getty Images for Heidi Klum Neil Patrick Harris and David Burtka
 The couple was unrecognizable as the twins from The Shining at Heidi Klum’s 25th annual Halloween Party.
 3 / 16 Noam Galai/Getty Images for Heidi Klum Kyle MacLachlan and Desiree Gruber
 Attending alongside his wife, the Sex and the City star was dressed as "the evil" Cliff Vandercave from his 1994 movie The Flintstones. 
 "This is a blast from the past with Flintstones ," he told E!. "Original costume. I don't think they know it's gone, so don't tell them."
 4 / 16 Noam Galai/Getty Images for Heidi Klum Lou Samuel, Johan Samuel and Leni Klum
 Klum's kids banded together on the red carpet for the party, which was presented by Apothic and Butterfinger at Cathédrale in New York City.
 5 / 16 Noam Galai/Getty Images for Heidi Klum Chase Hudson
 The influencer channeled American Psycho by dressing as Patrick Bateman.
 “I thought this fit the New York atmosphere,” he told E! News. “A little bit of Wall Street, a little bit of money and a little bit of heartbreak and some pain.”
 6 / 16 Noam Galai/Getty Images for Heidi Klum James Charles
 The beauty influencer spent seven and a half hours transforming into Yzma from  The Emperor's New Groove . 
 "I did prosthetics, and I'm not a special effects makeup artist, so that definitely tacked on a little bit more time than I would normally need," he told E!. "It's one of my favorite movies from when I was a kid. It's just a great way to combine glamor, camp, color and a lot of effort for Halloween."
 7 / 16 Noam Galai/Getty Images for Heidi Klum Taylor Momsen
 The Gossip Girl alum embraced her rock skills for All Hallows' Eve.
 "I've been on tour with AC/DC for the past three years," she told E!. "I'm Angus Young tonight."
 8 / 16 Noam Galai/Getty Images for Heidi Klum Questlove
 The musician got in the NFL spirit with a San Francisco 49ers jersey and blinged helmet accessory.
 9 / 16 Noam Galai/Getty Images for Heidi Klum Valentina Sampaio
 You'll be green with envy over the model's Poison Ivy look.
 10 / 16 Noam Galai/Getty Images for Heidi Klum Andrew Rannells and Tuc Watkins
 The Girls alum and One Life to Live actor appear to have crashlanded on the shores of Heidi Klum's party.
 11 / 16 Noam Galai/Getty Images for Heidi Klum Karen Mulder
 The Victoria's Secret model wore Karl Lagerfeld 's personal clothing while dressing as the late designer. 
 "These are his actual clothes, and these are his actual sunglasses as well," she told E! News on the red carpet. "They're prescription, so I'm looking at everybody a little fuzzy."
 12 / 16 Noam Galai/Getty Images for Heidi Klum Mariah Strongin
 Wonder Woman to the rescue!
 13 / 16 Noam Galai/Getty Images for Heidi Klum Ida Kulis
 The model was bewitching in her attire.
 14 / 16 Noam Galai/Getty Images for Heidi Klum Christian Beck
 Beck struck a pose on the carpet.
 15 / 16 Noam Galai/Getty Images for Heidi Klum David Kirsch
 No angel is complete without silver abs.
 16 / 16 Noam Galai/Getty Images for Heidi Klum Rebecca Mir and Massimo Sinató
 The pair coordinated in all-black ensembles.
